name: Nước lá Lao
summary: Nước lá Lao is a drink of dried forest leaves, astringent and fragrant when it is cooked. It is called particular to the island, and the same leaves are also known elsewhere in Quảng.
origin: Cham Islands. Dried forest leaves from Tân Hiệp, cooked as a daily drink. The 25 June 2017 note also places the leaves elsewhere in Quảng.
taste: The cooked drink is astringent and smells of the mixed leaves, among them bồ đề, dỏ dẽ, từ bi, ngũ gia bì, hà thủ ô, and sâm núi.
howToEat: As a daily drink. The leaves are cut, dried, and mixed, then cooked.
In 2017 a 300 gram pack was about 20,000 VND and the wholesale leaf about 50,000 VND a kilogram. Those are pack prices from that year.
seoTitle: Nước lá Lao — forest-leaf drink, Cham Islands
seoDescription: A dried-leaf drink from Tân Hiệp, astringent and fragrant when cooked. It is called particular to the island, and the leaves are also known in Quảng.
